title: [AAPS3.0_beta3] NSClient - Cant select local Profile, and can't download NS Profile (was beta2)
symptom: In AAPS 3.0 beta3, the user cannot select a local profile and cannot download a Nightscout profile. Even after creating a manual local profile and activating it, NSClient still says 'NO PROFILE SET' and no data appears on the plot.
cause: In v3.0 only local profiles are allowed; using NS profiles directly is not permitted. Also, MAX DIA is limited to 7 hours, so a DIA greater than 7 prevents profile selection.
fix: Change DIA to 7 or less to allow selection. Download NS profiles into local profiles and sync them, but use only local profiles. The button text issue was fixed by commit 3a33529307da30810ae273123cda12cb0f1743f6.
evidence_quote: In v3.0 only local profiles are allowed. You can download NS profiles into your local profiles and sync them, but using is only allowed for local profiles. Perhaps that's the problem ?
